remediation.analysis: The route interpolates req.query.name directly into an HTML string sent via res.send(). If name contains HTML/JS payloads (e.g., <script>), it will be reflected into the response and executed by the browser (reflected XSS, CWE-79).
remediation.remediation_strategy: HTML-escape the untrusted query parameter before embedding it into the HTML response. This preserves the route’s behavior (still returns an <h1> greeting) while preventing injected markup/scripts from being interpreted by the browser.
assumptions: This endpoint is intended to return a small HTML fragment and not render templates.
Escaping the name value is acceptable (i.e., user-provided HTML is not intended to be rendered as HTML).
